title: The first drawing of it
logline: A 1999 daily from Box 2, on the drafting table: the stone head in a background panel, three strokes, behind a dog. The sequence's last page finds the strip drew it first and didn't notice. The page draws the page.

panels.composition: A drafting table under the lamp with an old four-panel newspaper strip laid on it, one panel showing a dog with three quick strokes of a stone face in the background, a fresh drawing of the same face beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table under a lamp with an old four-panel comic strip laid on it, one panel showing a dog with a stone face sketched in three strokes behind it, a fresh detailed drawing of the same face beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The strip drew it first and didn't notice.
